titulo: Leaving while the evening is good
caption:
Leaving while the evening is good

The evening was still going well, so she left. The host asked her to stay and then asked her back.

Leaving while it is good costs the last half hour, and the host remembers the whole thing as good.

For whoever leaves a friend's house while the evening is still good.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a closed cream door on the right. Two block figures with white eyes stand together, one ink-black and one royal blue, both smiling. The ink-black one walks toward the door and a bubble says heading out! The royal blue one opens its eyes wide and says already? stay! The ink-black one answers next time. loved it., the door swings open to warm yellow light, and the figure walks into the doorway. Both turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from me: stay till it fades, to left while it was good. they asked me back.
